</a><div class="htext ddd-truncated" style="overflow-wrap: break-word;"><h1><a href="/article/71138/festsandevents-forever-uncleans-road-to-fest">Forever Unclean's Road to Fest</a></h1><p>We are pleased to bring to you a special Punknews Exclusive of Danish punks <a href="/bands/foreverunclean">Forever Unclean</a>'s Road to Fest playlist. The punk band has toured all over Europe and is finally embarking on a <a href="https://www.punknews.org/article/70957/tours-forever-unclean-southeast">mini-tour</a> in the US as they make their way to their appearance at Gainesville The Fest. You can see below to check out their tour playlist and go check them out at Fest, they play Sunday, Nov 3rd… </p></div> <a class="read-more" href="/article/71138/festsandevents-forever-uncleans-road-to-fest" title="read more">Read more</a>

The LP is self released in Europe and out via Closed Casket in USA.
